units.literal: Your servant then entered the city with Wang Jun, divided troops to guard the four gates; Sizhan's subordinate troops had all already belted on arms; we then reached the headquarters office, ordered that when Zhao Sizhan arrived he should be seized, and together with his whole party of followers all were dealt with."

units.zh: 郭從義奏，處斬前巡檢使喬守溫，供奉官王益、時知化、任繼勛等。
units.en: Guo Congyi memorialized that the former inspection commissioner Qiao Shouwen and the palace service officials Wang Yi, Shi Zhihua, Ren Jixun, and others had been executed.
units.literal: Guo Congyi memorialized that the former inspection commissioner Qiao Shouwen, the palace service officials Wang Yi, Shi Zhihua, Ren Jixun, and others were executed.

units.zh: 及郭從義率兵攻討，令守溫部署役夫。
units.en: When Guo Congyi led troops to attack and suppress them, he ordered Shouwen to deploy corvée laborers.
units.literal: When Guo Congyi led troops to attack and suppress them, he ordered Shouwen to deploy corvée laborers.

units.zh: 戊辰，客省使李嚴使蜀回。
units.en: On wuchen Li Yan returned from Shu.
units.literal: On wuchen Guest Reception commissioner Li Yan returned from an embassy to Shu.

units.zh: 嚴不獲珍貨，歸而奏之，帝大怒曰：「物歸中夏者命之曰『入草』，王衍寧免為入草之人耶！」
units.en: Yan brought back no treasures and reported it; Cunxu thundered, "Goods that reach China are called 'entering grass'—is Wang Yan not a man who enters the grass!"
units.literal: Yan obtained no curios; on returning he memorialized this, and the Emperor raged: "Goods that reach the Central Realm are called 'entering grass'—can Wang Yan escape being a man who enters the grass!"

units.zh: 初，帝令往市蜀中珍玩，蜀法嚴峻，不許奇貨東出，其許市者謂之「入草物」。
units.en: Cunxu had sent him to buy Shu luxuries; Shu law barred rare goods from the east, allowing only what it called "entering-grass goods."
units.literal: Earlier the Emperor had ordered him to buy Shu curios; Shu law was severe and did not allow rare goods to leave eastward—what was permitted was called "entering-grass goods."

units.zh: 壬午，以前蔚州刺史張溫為振武留後，以左右廂突陣指揮使康義誠為汾州刺史，以左右廂馬軍都指揮使索自通為忻州刺史。
units.en: On renwu, Zhang Wen, former prefect of Weizhou, was made acting military commissioner of Zhenwu; Kang Yicheng, commander of the left and right wing assault formations, was made prefect of Fenzhou; and Suo Zitong, cavalry commander-in-chief of the left and right wings, was made prefect of Xinzhou.
units.literal: On renwu, former Weizhou prefect Zhang Wen was made Zhenwu acting military commissioner; left-and-right wing assault-array commander Kang Yicheng was made Fenzhou prefect; left-and-right wing cavalry commander Suo Zitong was made Xinzhou prefect.

units.zh: 郭威以書召道先歸，留其副趙上交、王度奉赟入朝太后，道乃辭赟先還。
units.en: Guo Wei summoned Dao back by letter, leaving deputies Zhao Shangjiao and Wang Du to escort Yun to the dowager; Dao took leave of Yun and went ahead.
units.literal: Guo Wei with a letter summoned Dao to return first, leaving his deputies Zhao Shangjiao and Wang Du to escort Yun to an audience with the empress dowager; Dao then took leave of Yun and returned ahead.

units.zh: 以皇子河南尹、判六軍諸衛事從厚為北京留守；
units.en: Prince Conghou of Henan became Beijing regent;
units.literal: the prince, Henan intendant judging the Six Armies and all guards Conghou, was made Beijing regent;

units.zh: 是日，契丹主坐崇元殿行入閣之禮，契丹主以舅蕭翰為宣武軍節度使。
units.en: That day the Khitan ruler held the entering-the-pavilion ceremony in Chongyuan Hall and appointed his uncle Xiao Han military governor of Xuanwu.
units.literal: That day the Khitan ruler sat in Chongyuan Hall and performed the ceremony of entering the pavilion; the Khitan ruler appointed his maternal uncle Xiao Han military governor of the Xuanwu army.

units.zh: 庚子，皇第二子金紫光祿大夫、檢校司徒從榮可檢校太保、同平章事、天雄軍節度使、鄴都留守。
units.en: On gengzi the second prince Li Congrong—Gold and Purple Glory grand master and acting Minister of Education—could become acting Grand Guardian, co-equal councilor, Tianxiong commissioner, and Yedu regent.
units.literal: On gengzi, the Emperor's second son, Gold and Purple Glory Grand Master, acting Minister of Education Li Congrong could be made acting Grand Guardian, co-equal Chief Councilor, Tianxiong military commissioner, and Yedu regent.

units.zh: 丙子，以北京副留守、太原尹孟知祥為檢校太傅、同平章事、成都尹、劍南西川節度副大使、知節度事、西山八國雲南都招撫等使；
units.en: On bingzi Meng Zhixiang—northern deputy regent and Taiyuan prefect—became acting Grand Tutor, chancellor, Chengdu prefect, Jiannan Xichuan vice commissioner and acting commissioner, and pacification commissioner for the western mountains and Yunnan;
units.literal: On bingzi, northern capital deputy regent and Taiyuan prefect Meng Zhixiang was made acting Grand Tutor, co-equal chief minister, Chengdu prefect, Jiannan Xichuan military vice commissioner, acting commissioner, and commissioner for pacification of the western mountains' eight states and Yunnan and the rest;
